title: V5 No-Repeat Registry — Proof of Methodological Divergence from V1–V4
authoritative_rule: No GPU compute may be allocated to an experiment whose mechanism was already ruled out by a closed V1-V4 gate. Every V5 experiment must prove non-identity with prior falsifications.
permanently_barred_mechanisms: Tabular patient metadata fusion (S33/S53r R7/S67 null)
Buggy colour constancy (S50/S53 invalid; S53r null)
Repeated reserved-cohort evaluation (8 prior reads, exhausted for confirmatory claims)

registry.name: 384px Input Resolution Foundation
registry.previous_experiment: S52 / S53r (R1 rung on recipe ladder)
registry.previous_verdict: LEVER (mean Delta +0.0297 Macro-F1 across 3 seeds; seed range +0.0097 to +0.0466)
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: R1 was the only positive lever on the 7-rung recipe ladder in S53r. It is adopted as the baseline canvas for all V5 backbones, evaluated paired against the matched 224px control.

registry.name: Dual-Stream Global (384px) + Lesion-Centered Local Crop (384px)
registry.previous_experiment: S50 spatial shortcut audit & S52 R1 full-image resize
registry.previous_verdict: S50 showed exterior vs interior decodability gap Delta +0.0297 (below 0.05 MCID); S52 only evaluated global resizing which downsampled delicate micro-reticulations
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Never tested in V1-V4. Prior work either resized the entire dermoscopy frame or audited mask margins. Dual-stream preserves 1:1 scale alongside macro-asymmetry, strictly evaluated against a capacity-matched single-stream control.

registry.name: Group-DRO Subgroup-Aware Minimax Learning
registry.previous_experiment: S67 arm B (hard-case reweighting) and S53r R4 (class-balanced sampler)
registry.previous_verdict: FAIL / NULL. S67 reweighting gave Delta under-40 pAUC -0.000 [-0.013, +0.012]; S53r R4 gave Delta Macro-F1 +0.0134 (NULL)
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: S67 applied class-level reweighting (mel vs nv), allowing 3,000 older lesions to dominate gradients. Group-DRO optimizes the worst-case group risk over G = {age_band x escalation} to prevent subgroup neglect without adversarial destruction.

registry.name: Modern 384px Backbones (ConvNeXt-V2, EfficientNetV2-M, SwinV2-Tiny-384)
registry.previous_experiment: S1 (CNN baseline), S33 (SwinV2-224), S51 (PanDerm ViT-B/16, DINOv2 frozen probes)
registry.previous_verdict: S1 established CNN ceiling; S33 SwinV2 at 224px without warm-up reached 0.7273; S51 frozen foundation probes failed (PanDerm Delta pAUC -0.0363, DINOv2 -0.0725)
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: S51 only evaluated frozen backbones with linear heads. S33 evaluated SwinV2 at 224px without modern cosine warm-up. ConvNeXt-V2 adds GRN to prevent dominant nevus channels from suppressing rare features; SwinV2-Tiny-384 provides hierarchical self-attention at native 384px.

registry.name: S75 Fresh External Evaluation Cohort Sourcing
registry.previous_experiment: S70 fresh cohort audit & S59 reserved evaluation
registry.previous_verdict: S70 confirmed 0 unread cohorts on disk; reserved cohort (104 under-40 escalating lesions) read 8 times across V4 and exhausted for confirmatory claims
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Directly implements S70 Owner Decision D1. Eliminates the reserved cohort exhaustion problem by sourcing a completely pristine external dataset for a single post-freeze confirmatory read.

registry.name: Morphology Feature Audit across Age Strata
registry.previous_experiment: S64 ceiling audit & S50 locus diagnostic
registry.previous_verdict: S64 proved under-40 AUC(d) capped at 0.8778 vs 0.9479 in 40-59, but only examined scalar decision score d, not visual dermatoscopic structures
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: First comprehensive quantitative dermatological morphology extraction across age strata in this repo. Analyzes pigment density, network irregularity, border compactness, and color entropy.

registry.name: Trainable Multi-Task Escalation Head
registry.previous_experiment: S40 (escalation head N2), S42 (MLP/GBM heads), S67 (specialist head)
registry.previous_verdict: All failed: S40 Delta pAUC -0.0670; S42 all Delta heads negative; S67 specialist head pAUC 0.6886 vs 0.7279 control
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Prior sessions tested classification heads on FROZEN representations (inheriting the base visual bottleneck). V5-B2 backpropagates auxiliary escalation gradients into the visual trunk during training.

registry.name: Hierarchical Coarse-to-Fine Diagnostic Tree
registry.previous_experiment: S33 flat 7-class head & S58 multi-task routing
registry.previous_verdict: Flat classification treats all 21 cross-class error pairs equally, masking critical melanoma-vs-nevus boundary confusion
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Imposes a coarse clinical escalation gate (malignant vs benign) before fine-grained 7-class assignment, aligning model penalty with dermatological urgency.

registry.name: Native-Resolution Micro-Patch Attention
registry.previous_experiment: S50 spatial patch audit & S52 full resize
registry.previous_verdict: S50 evaluated macro-quadrants; S52 evaluated global 384px resizing without local zooming
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Crops 96-160px patches directly from native high-resolution image prior to downsampling, preserving fine sub-millimeter reticulations with lightweight cross-attention.

registry.name: Soft Interior / Boundary / Context Decomposition
registry.previous_experiment: S50 exterior decodability audit & R3 hard masking
registry.previous_verdict: R3 hard masking removed 100% of context, harming sensitivity due to loss of perilesional contrast; S50 only measured shortcut decodability
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Evaluates continuous soft context modulation alpha in [0, 1] with validated HAM masks rather than binary destructive masking.

registry.name: Trainable End-to-End MEL-vs-NV Dedicated Branch
registry.previous_experiment: S67 arm A (frozen specialist head)
registry.previous_verdict: FALSIFIED in S67: under-40 pAUC dropped to 0.6886 on frozen embeddings
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Jointly trains a dedicated binary melanoma-vs-nevus branch end-to-end with the visual trunk on development hard negatives, not on frozen features.

registry.name: Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning
registry.previous_experiment: S53r R5 (Metric learning / CosFace proxy)
registry.previous_verdict: NULL in S53r: Delta Macro-F1 +0.0076
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: R5 tested margin-loss classification proxies (CosFace). SupCon directly contrasts multiview augmentations within diagnostic class while pushing hard negative mimics (young MEL vs young NV) apart in latent space.

registry.name: Haar Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) High-Frequency Branch
registry.previous_experiment: None in V1-V4
registry.previous_verdict: Untested in prior phases
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Explicitly separates high-frequency horizontal, vertical, and diagonal sub-bands (LH, HL, HH) to capture fine pigment network reticulations and vascular structures, evaluated against a capacity-matched control.

registry.name: Radial/Polar Coordinate Representation
registry.previous_experiment: None in V1-V4
registry.previous_verdict: Untested in prior phases
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Dermatoscopic structures (pseudopods, radial streaming) naturally radiate outward from the centroid. Polar coordinate mapping converts rotational boundary patterns into translational invariants.

registry.name: Morphology-Gated Multi-Expert Ensemble Routing
registry.previous_experiment: S58 (H2 domain router) and S66 (per-centre lambda)
registry.previous_verdict: S58 domain router failed to beat soft voting; S66 per-centre rules produced REJECT-cost
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: S58 routed on dataset archive; S66 routed on clinical hospital center. V5-B10 routes dynamically based on visual morphology predictions without demographic inputs.

registry.name: Adaptive Generalized Mean (GeM) Feature Pooling
registry.previous_experiment: Standard GAP in all backbones
registry.previous_verdict: GAP averages out sparse, isolated focal structures (e.g. solitary pseudopod)
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Tests whether learnable Generalized Mean pooling (p=3) prevents spatial dilution of highly localized dermoscopic hallmarks compared to standard GAP.

registry.name: Pairwise Melanoma-vs-Nevus Margin Ranking Loss
registry.previous_experiment: Standard cross-entropy and class-reweighted loss
registry.previous_verdict: S67 class reweighting failed Delta under-40 pAUC -0.000; cross-entropy lacks explicit ranking margins
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Directly optimizes relative ordering between young melanoma and benign nevi within mini-batches, enforcing a strict score separation margin on development pairs.

registry.name: 384px Mixup / CutMix Sensitivity Analysis
registry.previous_verdict: Null at 224px resolution
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Tests whether the modern 384px representation alters the earlier null result with colour-safe alpha <= 0.2. Not part of core compute.

registry.name: Optional SWA Schedule Ablation
registry.previous_experiment: S53 R6 (EMA + Cosine)
registry.previous_verdict: Incomplete due to early stopping at epoch 19/60
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Executed only if final checkpoints demonstrate terminal validation loss instability.

registry.name: Exploratory Imbalance-Loss Sensitivity (Focal Loss)
registry.previous_experiment: LDAM, ASL, class reweighting
registry.previous_verdict: Loss adjustments hit ranking ceilings
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Tested only as low-cost development probe; does not consume 5-fold compute.

registry.name: Balanced Softmax Logit Adjustment Probe
registry.previous_experiment: S58 prior correction
registry.previous_verdict: S58 global prior adjustment was null
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Documented to prevent scope creep; not part of active GPU execution.

registry.name: Foundation Model Feature Distillation Probe
registry.previous_experiment: S51 frozen PanDerm / DINOv2 probes
registry.previous_verdict: FALSIFIED as frozen feature extractors
registry.why_not_a_repeat_of_failed_idea: Tests knowledge transfer as a teacher to high-res student; deferred to avoid diverting core visual representation resources.
